contexts.text: The publishing of the errors of others.
Spirits who strove that nothing should be published about them. (They were Dutch Spirits. See SE 3499.)
(The Spirits of Jupiter) requested me not to publish (this).
For the Spiritual (of the Word) is made manifest with the Angels, when the Word is being read by man.
When effects alone are examined, they do not make manifest any cause.
Their interiors are said to be bound because they are not made manifest.
Some things are to be published about them, which I have received from their lips.
You would be ashamed to publish (your idea of three Gods); for if you were to publish it, you would be called insane...
This shall be made public in brief...
Like the Spirits of Mercury, they do not want to make public the things they know...
With the evil (the end) does not make itself manifest in the speech of words. SE 3638:end.
(The Quaker Spirits) did not want their interior quality to be made public, having this from the life of the body, that nothing should be made public.
As soon as external bonds are taken away, the interiors are made manifest.
Lest this crime should be made public...
Many things recounted to me, which it is not allowable to make public.
Profane things which I scarcely dare make public.
